description: List the apps this Rivioo user saved: their own apps and competitors, each with store, app_id and default country (for Google Play the default country picks the review languages). Use it to look up an app the user names before calling rivioo_review_stats, rivioo_search_reviews or rivioo_get_reviews. Free; delivers no reviews.
name: rivioo_my_apps

last_collected_at.description: When reviews for the default country were last collected; null if never.

charged_this_call.description: Reviews this call read for the first time in 30 days.

free_rereads_this_call.description: Reviews this call returned free because they were first read in the last 30 days.

remaining.description: Reviews this account can still read for the first time this month.

title: My apps
